literal_meaning: to form a secret plot or alliance (derived from 'ṣaḍ' meaning six, implying a group conspiracy)
figurative_meaning_bn: ষড়যন্ত্র করা; গোপনে মিল/যোগ থাকা; গুপ্তসন্ধি থাকা
figurative_meaning_en: to conspire; to have a secret connection or alliance; to form a clandestine pact
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা দুজনে মিলে সড় করছে আমার বিরুদ্ধে।
অফিসে কয়েকজন কর্মী গোপনে সড় থাকার সন্দেহ হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The two of them are conspiring against me.
Several employees in the office are suspected of having a secret alliance.
note: The idiom derives from Sanskrit 'ṣaḍyantara' implying a plot involving six elements, but no specific historical event in Bengali context.
